summary:
The PR hardens exact-match recovery-key and database-key input schemas against additional blank or invisible Unicode characters while preserving the established internal-line-break behavior.
- Rejects nonspacing marks, space separators, most control characters, braille blank, and selected Hangul fillers.
- Expands contract tests across rejection boundaries, minimum-length handling, and deliberate allowed characters.
- Adds API wire and Playwright coverage proving malformed inputs receive HTTP 400 responses.
- Documents the security rationale, compatibility tradeoffs, and current verification evidence.
confidenceReasoning:
The PR appears safe to merge, with the issue #334 validation behavior consistently implemented and covered at contract, wire, and end-to-end seams.

The widened validator blocks the targeted blank and invisible Unicode inputs, preserves the documented newline behavior, and has no identified changed-code path producing an actionable regression.
